glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形) – a street intersection. Original form of 行 (“place”). Later phonetically borrowed (假借) to represent 行 (“to go”). Originally symmetric, it has been simplified asymmetrically; the left half 彳 is widely used as a radical, while the right half 亍 finds occasional use, and the character can be broken up as 彳 + 亍, though originally it was not a compound.
